Financial year 2017 was a tough year for most
businesses and Eveready was no exception.
We experienced a significant downturn in
the economy following a prolonged period of
electioneering coupled with insecurity in certain
segments of the market, weak credit growth,
creeping inflation and drought. As a result, there
was a decline in disposable incomes leading to a
generally depressed consumer purchasing power.
